a.lede: Farooq Abbasi, an investor in Neko Health, talked to Equity about the hot health tech company and what's next for it.
a.title: Spotify billionaire’s body scan startup has come to America

b.lede: Spotify founder Daniel Ek’s Neko Health raised $700 million to build a business around scanning your body, but it’s not the only company centering its roadmap around a new kind of preventative healthcare. Midjourney is building its own body scanner, while Function Health has also raised significant capital to build out its preventative-health platform. Why are investors betting so big
b.title: Is Neko Health’s body scan worth it? Spotify billionaire’s startup has come to America
